name: paulmann/ai-revoap
description: RevoAp — multi-LLM consensus platform with a 4-layer AI pipeline, a durable job queue, an append-only audit trail and a fully localised (en/de/ru/zh/ar) Tailwind + shadcn/ui console.

suggest.ext-intl: Full CLDR date/number formatting for the five shipped locales. Without it App\I18n\Translator falls back to a built-in table that covers the UI's needs.
suggest.ext-opcache: Strongly recommended in production; see deploy/php/opcache-recommended.ini.
suggest.ext-redis: Enables the shared cache backend for multi-worker deployments (cache.backend = redis).
suggest.ext-pcntl: Lets bin/revoap-worker.php handle SIGTERM/SIGUSR1 for graceful draining under systemd.
suggest.ext-zlib: Compressed audit-log rotation and response-cache storage.

scripts.lint: find src bin index.php config.php -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.test:smoke: Run the standalone smoke suite (no PHPUnit required).
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Run every standalone test script and print a pass/fail summary.
scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every first-party PHP file.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:lint: Verify every shipped catalog covers every key of en.json.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:extract: Re-extract translation keys used in PHP/JS into i18n/_keys.json.
scripts-descriptions.build:css: Compile ui/tailwind.css into assets/dist/revoap.css (local, no CDN).
scripts-descriptions.build:assets: Bundle + fingerprint every front-end asset into assets/dist/.
scripts-descriptions.check: Lint + analyse + test — the same gate CI enforces.
